title: Battle of the Monolith
start: Talk to Ali the Wise or Wizard Trindy at the Archaeology Campus.

recommended.t: Archaeology journal (For easy teleport to the start & replays of the quest)
TokKul-Zo (For quick teleport to the TzHaar City during the third battle of the quest)

kills.t: The player is never required to engage in combat in order to complete this quest, as long as allies are placed correctly.
Several Temple Knights (scales with your combat level)
Several Abyssal Prowlers (scales with your combat level)
Several Elite Shadow Cacklers (level 111 and 24,000 lifepoints)

steps.t: Talk to Ali the Wise or Wizard Trindy found north west of the mysterious monolith (Archaeology Guild). [Chat: accept]
Move Thaerisk Cemphier, Commander Zilyana, and Helwyr south-west of the barricade.
Press the start button to begin the battle.
Talk to Ali the Wise.
Move Helwyr and Nex just inside the southern barricade.
Move Zilyana and Thaerisk just inside the northern barricade.
Start the battle.
Talk to Wizard Trindy or Ali the Wise. [Chat: 3 The TokHaar?]
Head to the Fight Kiln and enter it. [Chat: 1 The Battle of the Monolith.]
Return to the Archaeology Guild and talk to Ali the Wise again. [Chat: 1 Begin the third battle.]
Move Helwyr and Commander Zilyana just outside the northern barricade of the Gower farm.
Move Thaerisk and Nex just outside the southern barricade of the Gower Farm.
Move the 3 TokHaar just outside the Varrock east gate.
Start the battle.
Talk to Ali the Wise.
Move Helwyr to the southern barricade.

sub.t: Helwyr is located west of the south barriers.

steps.t: Move Thaerisk and Nex to the crossroads outside Varrock's east gate. (Sometimes an enemy can slip the crossroads defence and start attacking the north-western barricade.)

sub.t: Nex is located south-east of Varrock.

steps.t: Move Commander Zilyana to the northern barricade.
Start the final battle.
Talk to Ali the Wise for a cutscene. [Chat: 3 Leave. › 1 Yes!]
